answer: Prayers & Duties >> Qurbani (Slaughtering) Question ID: 27313 Country: India Title: Plz tell me the age of goat to be slautered at baqr eid if the criterion of age fails with 2or 3 months but the goat is healthy and of adequate physique. can we do qurbani. Question: plz tell me the age of goat to be slautered at baqr eid if the criterion of age fails with 2or 3 months but the goat is healthy and of adequate physique. can we do qurbani. Answer ID: 27313 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1645/1645/M=1431) It is necessary for the goat to be of one complete year. The qurbani of a two or three month goat is not lawful though it looks fat and healthy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
